You are performing fail-closed visual QA for an official museum collection image used as a responsive website hero. Inspect the actually opened image at a phone-width/mobile presentation, not merely its metadata. This is not OCR QA because the museum image has no GPT-generated text; OCR exact match is N/A. Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown, with keys asset_key, opened_and_inspected, subject_clear_at_mobile_scale, compression_or_scaling_artifacts, other_delivery_defects, verdict, notes. Use asset_key "480" and verdict "pass" only if opened_and_inspected=true, subject_clear_at_mobile_scale=true, compression_or_scaling_artifacts=false, and other_delivery_defects=false.
